  PROBLEM: The `first_hunk_header.startswith("@@ -1")` guard is too loose and can match hunks whose old-start line number merely begins with `1`, not just hunks starting at line 1.
  WHY: A deleted file whose diff hunk starts at line 10+ and contains a generated-marker substring can be incorrectly classified as generated, causing its diff to be stripped from reviewer-visible output.

  PROBLEM: The `detect_generated_marker_in_block` guard `first_hunk_header.startswith("@@ -1")` is too loose and matches hunks starting at line 10, 100, 15, and similar non-line-1 locations.
  WHY: When the workspace file is missing and the fallback block scan runs, a deleted file with later-line generated-marker text can be incorrectly treated as generated and dropped from reviewer-visible diffs.

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- scripts/review_filter_uninteresting_files.sh:75 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The hunk header guard uses a loose prefix check `startswith("@@ -1")` which incorrectly matches hunk headers like `@@ -10,5 +10,5 @@`, `@@ -100,...`, and `@@ -15 +15 @@`.
  WHY: If a deleted file's diff hunk starts at line 10, 100, etc. and contains a generated-marker substring, it will be incorrectly classified as generated and dropped from reviewer-visible diffs.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
- scripts/review_filter_uninteresting_files.sh:74 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `detect_generated_marker_in_block` uses `startswith("@@ -1")` which matches any hunk header containing the substring "@@ -1", including non-line-1 hunks such as `@@ -10,5 +10,5 @@`.
  WHY: This can activate the fallback scan on hunks that do not cover the beginning of the file, causing deleted/generated files with later-line generated-marker text to be dropped from reviewer-visible artifacts.
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
